hypothesis: The real-Zebrahub edge head ranks daughters but its original loss gives division rows unit weight; a conservative transformer-only continuation that upweights true daughter edges can improve division precision/recall without changing the detector.
parent: Real-Zebrahub full checkpoint SHA 3300ccd2 with verified 256-train/64-valid time split and 21-frame gap.
candidate: Resume all weights; freeze U-Net and detection head in eval mode; train only SimpleNodeTransformer for one epoch at 2e-5. Weight a division row 2x and its two positive daughter cells 8x in the existing focal BCE.
selection: Compare candidate to parent on the same external validation shards using teacher-forced GT-node thresholds [0.5,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.02]. Proceed to untouched competition source folds only if division-parent F1 at 0.5 improves and overall edge recall at 0.5 does not fall by more than 0.01.
competition_gate: If external gate passes, score fixed scratch coordinates on the two source-validation movies in each reciprocal direction; target OOF remains unopened until both directions have a nonnegative source score/recall selection.
resource: One RTX6000 through the common queue; 8 CPU, 32 GiB RAM, 4 GiB disk, 45 minutes. One GPU job for this project.
